finding: The host-side native TDX verifier timed out during the control TLS handshake before the burst phase could be dispatched. The guest logged the matching control-handshake timeout. There is no burst receipt or backend-fault result for this attempt.
follow_up: The host client may retry one TLS deadline failure only when TLSHandshakeDone reports a wrapped context deadline and WroteHeaders has not run. Image/attestation rejection and any failure after HTTP dispatch remain fatal. The overall deadline, guest binaries, attestation policy and workload are unchanged.
